title: underscore: change the internal group() helper to an options object
prompt: This is a copy of Underscore 1.13.7 (modules/, ES modules). The internal helper `modules/_group.js` takes a bare boolean second parameter, `group(behavior, partition)`, which makes call sites such as `}, true);` unreadable. Change it to `group(behavior, { partition } = {})` and update every caller so that the one that wants the two-bucket mode passes `{ partition: true }` and the others pass nothing. A bare boolean must no longer switch the mode. groupBy, countBy, indexBy and partition must behave exactly as before.
